plan: Keep the authored recipe immutable: deep-copy it on entry to adapt(); print_original() just returns authored_text unchanged, so the original always prints exactly as authored.

Scale first: compute ratio = target_yield / recipe yield as a Fraction and multiply every ingredient quantity (including component ingredients and substitution-introduced extras) by it, so the adapted recipe is complete at the target yield.
Index the catalog by the 'for' name and sort each bucket by (priority, catalog index); the first entry is the deterministic winner, satisfying lower-priority-wins with catalog order as tie-breaker.

Resolve each ingredient recursively: if its name is excluded, apply the winning catalog choice (name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation), collect wording_changes pairs and equipment additions/removals, then re-resolve the replacement and any additional ingredients so chained substitutions and reintroduced exclusions are handled; a per-chain name set detects cycles.

Accumulate every failure independently in a set — 'no substitution for NAME', 'substitution cycle involving NAME', and one 'equipment NAME unavailable' per missing final equipment item — so impossibility reports all applicable reasons sorted, not just the first.

Only if no reasons exist, materialize the adapted recipe: apply collected wording (old→new) replacements to all instruction strings (top-level and per-component), sort the final equipment list, set yield to the target, and return sorted warnings plus the ordered list of chosen catalog IDs.
mechanisms: Deep-copy working state so neither adapt() nor print_original() mutates inputs
Rational scaling with fractions.Fraction ratio applied uniformly to all quantities
Catalog bucketed by target name, sorted by (priority, catalog index) for deterministic choice
Recursive resolution with a chain-name set for chained substitution and cycle detection
Reason accumulation in a set to report all independent impossibility causes
Deferred application of wording changes and equipment edits, materialized only on success
